Just What I Need. This app is just what I need to get my feet wet in Pilates. I have zero experience with Pilates and a lot of medical restrictions, but I’m on Day 10 and, even though the workouts are gradually feeling more challenging, they aren’t overwhelming or too difficult for me to accomplish. My only criticism is that I’m unable to play my own (or any) inspirational musical while I workout. I’m forced to exercise in silence without an external source of music playing. That’s kind of a bummer. Otherwise, I’m completely satisfied with this app and I’m so happy it exists! Thank you!
Exercise. Short and precise!

Good habits, spammy adverts. If you can stick with having to close the same ad 4-6 times before it actually goes away then you can really develop a good routine with this app. It takes about 5 minutes a day, and I’ve felt stronger in my core since using it consistently for a month. 
The workouts don’t get harder with each batch of days, but it’s the same movements mixed in different combinations. Each movement focuses on a different part of the core, glutes, or legs. 
Despite the spam level of adverts it’s one of the better free Pilates apps out there that I’ve found
